tasks.title: Calibrating vbat_scale
tasks.solution: In battery.c the voltage is proportional to vbat_scale: V = ADC·scale·3300/(4095·1000). So new = old × V_multimeter / V_INAV. If INAV reads low, scale goes up.

tasks.title: current_meter_scale from the charger
tasks.solution: I = (U_sensor − offset)/scale, the reading is inversely proportional to scale: new = old × mAh_INAV / mAh_charger. If INAV reads high, scale has to be increased.

tasks.title: current_meter_offset from the idle current
tasks.solution: In the code offset×0.1 mV is subtracted from the sensor voltage, which removes offset/scale amps. So new = old + (I_INAV − I_ammeter) × scale. A negative result is valid: INAV was reading the current low.

tasks.title: Estimating nav_mc_hover_thr from T/W
tasks.solution: In a hover thrust equals weight: (throttle)² · T_max = T_max / TW, so the throttle fraction = 1/√TW, nav_mc_hover_thr = 1000 + 1000/√TW. This is a starting estimate; the exact value is taken from the Blackbox log of the first hover.
